name: Harbor Light
flavor: Close enough to the Landing that most people assume it's decorative. It isn't.

beats.title: Everyone Assumes It's Decorative
beats.body: Close enough to the Landing's noise and lights that most people assume Harbor Light is purely ornamental at this point. It isn't. It's on a working schedule, same as the other two.

beats.title: Not Built for Ships
beats.body: A faded builder's plaque gives a construction date that lines up, almost exactly, with the Archive's collapse — not before it, as a warning system would be, but after.

beats.title: The Triangle
beats.body: Lay the three towers out on any map of the island and they don't point out to sea at all — they point inward, to the same spot. The Ruins sit dead center of the three.
